中心自己不需要有 agent；每台设备上跑一个本地节点。 备份按复制序号一条条追: The hub needs no agent of its own; every device runs one local node. The standby catches up in replication sequence row by row, and may take over only after the checks pass; takeover rotates the credential generation, so anything the old hub sends afterwards is rejected outright. 局域网里，或者隔着半个国家: On the LAN, or half a country away
同一台设备、同一个局域网、异地——三种连法用同一套东西，不需要为「远程」再部署一: Same device, same LAN, remote site — three ways to connect over the same pieces, with no second service deployed for "remote". It runs inside a trusted private network by default: for a remote site, pull both machines into one private network with a tunnel or mesh, and never expose the port to the public internet.
没有远端也能跑：导入、抽取、召回都在本机完成。: Runs with no remote at all: ingest, extraction and recall all happen here.
设备地址簿里记一条 LAN 地址，节点按顺序试，连上就走。: One LAN address in the device address book; the node tries them in order and goes with the first that connects.
地址簿里再加一条；上次成功的排最前面，换网不用先等一条死路超时。: Add one more entry to the address book; the last successful one goes first, so changing networks does not wait out a dead path.
认机器，不认地址: Trust the machine, not the address
每台设备用自己的私钥签名，中心提前钉好公钥。签名不绑 IP，换网络不用重新配对；: Each device signs with its own private key, and the hub pins the public key in advance. A signature is not tied to an IP, so changing networks needs no re-pairing; but without that private key, holding the same IP still fails to sign.
所有对外通信走同一个加密端口，设备和中心互相验身份；不另开管理口、调试口。: All external traffic goes over one encrypted port, device and hub authenticating each other; there is no separate management or debug port.
一次性配对码换设备身份；之后靠签名，不靠密码。: A single-use pairing code trades for a device identity; after that, signatures carry the trust, not passwords.
转录读也认设备: Transcript reads check the device too
四条转录读路由只对已配对设备开放；读一次落一行审计，只记谁读了哪个会话，不记正文: The four transcript read routes are open only to paired devices; each read leaves one audit row recording who read which session, never the text.
密钥只从管道进，不进模型、不进参数表；每个 agent 的小本各用一把独立钥匙。: Keys come in only through a pipe, never into the model or the argument table; each agent's notebook uses its own key.
账本不出中心: The ledger never leaves the hub
配额和进度只留在中心，备份里也没有；私钥从不以明文进备份。: Quota and progress stay on the hub and are absent from backups; a private key never enters a backup in plaintext.
多台设备、多个 agent，谁看得到谁: Many devices, many agents: who sees whom
默认按「可信 agent 环境」设计：同一局域网里的已配对设备都算自己人。世界记: The default is a trusted agent environment: paired devices on the same LAN count as insiders. World memory is shared; core stays per agent.
同一主人名下的 agent 把会话都交进这份库，抽取统一在中心跑；大家都能查、都: Agents under the same owner hand their sessions into this one store, and extraction runs on the hub; everyone can query it, keep building on it, and pick up on another device.
每个 agent 的加密小本各用一把独立钥匙；core_* 只对这一个 agen: Each agent's encrypted notebook has its own key; core_* opens only to that one agent identity, and no other agent can reach it.

，不会假装中心零命中。: — never pretending the hub had zero hits.
默认前提：同一局域网里的已配对设备视为可信——能配对进来，就能读中心会话，不再按: Default premise: paired devices on the same LAN are trusted — if it can pair in, it can read hub sessions, with no further split by owner. This LAN trust applies only to transcript reads; world memory and core keep their original gates. Do not pair in untrusted devices, and do not expose the hub to the public internet; for a remote site, use a tunnel or mesh to pull the machines into one private network.

。拿着它能换回那条记忆。: in front of a recall result. Holding it gets that memory back.
一条记忆指向原始对话里某一轮、某一段的编号。原文不动，指针就不失效。: The number by which a memory points at one turn, one passage, in the raw transcript. As long as the raw text stays put, the pointer does not go stale.
处理到第几行的记号。成功了才前移，失败就停在那，下次接着来。: A mark of how far processing got. It advances only on success; on failure it stops there and picks up next time.
一道自动检查。过不了就不往下走，并写清原因；不是靠人盯着。: An automatic check. Fail it and nothing moves forward, with the reason written down; no one has to watch.
连不上中心时，节点在本地暂存的数据上继续做抽取，不等网。: When the hub is unreachable, the node keeps extracting over locally staged data instead of waiting for the network.
网络恢复后，把本地攒下的东西按固定顺序送回中心，一步不能跳。: Once the network returns, locally accumulated data goes back to the hub in a fixed order, no step skipped.
一个人、一个项目、一台机器在库里的固定身份；关于它的记忆都挂在上面。: The fixed identity in the store for a person, a project, a machine; memories about it hang from that anchor.
同一份东西送两次，只算一次，不会写重。: The same thing sent twice counts once and is never written twice.
备份追平并核对通过后转正；旧中心随即被挡住，不能再写。: The standby is promoted once it has caught up and passed the check; the old hub is blocked right after and can no longer write.
某一刻整份记忆的拷贝；发布时下发给节点，平时按增量同步。: A copy of the whole memory at one moment; handed to nodes at publish time, synced by delta in between.
按会话或 turn_uid 从中心取原话；四条只读路由只对已配对设备开放。: Fetching raw words from the hub by session or turn_uid; the four read-only routes are open only to paired devices.
面向 agent 的通用长期记忆服务。原始记录是事实源，记忆是索引。: A general long-term memory service for agents. Raw records are the source of truth; memory is the index.
